preparation.label: Cooked at a central kitchen and delivered

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: There was not a current children's products annual certification available for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two caregivers out of four files reviewed did not have the following HASA trainings available for review.   1.Administering medication 2. Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction. 3. Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials. 4.Understand building and premises safety  5.Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations 6. Emergency preparedness
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The playground did not have the required six inch of loose-fill throughout the playground and around the slides.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Caregiver was observed finishing a diapering and did not wash hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Two Caregivers were missing the pre-employment afidavit #2912.  One employee was missing a translated copy of their education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Two children were missing wellness statements signed by a healthcare professional.  One child was missing an emergency contact address.  One child was missing a signed allergy plan by a healthcare professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Caregiver was observed finishing a diapering and did not wash the childs hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: A 18 mo old was observed to be sitting in a highchair upon arrival. A volunteer was observed removing the child from the chair and telling them they could not hit and not to hit again. The caregiver of the gorup initally stated the chair is only used for eating. After being informed of the volunteer's statement, the caregiver then stated it is used but for only 1 minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Caregivers in the 2yr old and 3-4yr old groupd were not aware of the ages of the children in their care. When asked caregivers either guessed the ages of the children or stated they didn't know becuase it was not their group.      NOTE: A staff meetingg will be held to discuss techiques for knowing children's information
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: 4 volunteers were observed to be present without notification of eligibilty from the Centralized background check unit.    NOTE: Background checks were submitted during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: Photo ID for 1 out of 6 staff files was not valid as it was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: 7 out of 8 children were signed in the Toddler 2 classroom during the inspection.    Note: The provider corrected this at the inspection by signing the child in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Emergency contact information was missing or incomplete for 3 out of 6 chidlren's files evaluated during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two caregivers were observed during the inspeciton. One caregiver had director access to children in careand the caregivers background check is in an inactive status. The provider has not obtained an eligiblity notification from CBCU stating the caregiver can be present. The other caregivers background check is still pending.    Note: Both caregivers left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Caregivers stated there were 7 children in care when there were 6 children accounted for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver did not know the ages of children in their group and did not have any information available showing their ages during the walk through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: Two children were not signed in to the tablet during the inspection.    Note: This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver signed each child in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The daily menu showed the food to be served was turkey and wheat bread and children were served tortillas with ground beef.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director wrote in the substitution on the menu.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The food allergy emergency plan for a child with a diagnosed food allergy was not signed by a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Children were observed eating cereal and crackers on the bare table during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: Soiled diapers were observed on the floor in the restroom and in a trash can that was not covered with any lid.    Note: The provider corrected this at the inspection when placing the soiled diaper in the trash can and covering it with the lid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill material does not measure to be 6 inches. An additional 2-3 inches is needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: Documentation stating how infants and children with limited mobility will be evacuated was missing in the written emergency preparedness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit did not contain a thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: A plan to ensure physical activty occurs on days when extreme weather prohibits children from doing outdoor time was missing from the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
